# Megamind Studios - Website & Brand Audit Consultation

This is the official landing page for booking a 1-on-1 website and brand audit consultation with Megamind Studios. Users can submit their business details, website link, and growth requirements to request a professional audit and consultation.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://megamind.studio/): The main landing page containing the audit value proposition, form submission modal/section, and contact/booking workflows.
- [Thank You Page](https://megamind.studio/thank-you): The confirmation page displayed after a user successfully submits their lead details for the audit.
